verdict.rationale: Vast.ai provides building blocks for automation: a full REST API, CLI, and Python SDK ('Automate with the CLI or SDK'), scoped API keys meant for CI/CD and automation, and an agent skill that lets AI assistants drive the platform. Serverless also offers automatic benchmark-driven scaling, and autobilling runs unattended. However, the evidence shows no native way to define and schedule background automations; users must build that orchestration themselves with external tools. Missing for 10: first-party scheduled jobs or cron triggers, event-driven automation workflows on the platform, and independent or hands-on evidence of autonomous background automations running.
